Resolution: Voxels per side of the baked 3D grid. Higher = more detail and polygons, slower and heavier.
Boundscenter: Centre of the sampled box in world units.
Boundssize: Size (X, Y, Z) of the sampled box in world units. Geometry outside it is clipped and left open.
Inflate: Iso-surface offset in world units. Positive grows the mesh, negative shrinks it.
Normals: none: no normals. gradient: smooth normals from the SDF gradient. surface: flat per-face normals.
